input_proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos, ← Fintype.card_set]
  refine (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP).mp ?_
  intro Q hQ hPQ
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
  intro T hT
  by_contra hT'
  exact hPS ⟨T, hT', fun U hU h =>
    hQ hT (hPQ hU) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr h)⟩
